item.description:
0.7.2

Cancelling a transfer no longer breaks the next command you type.

  • Cancel left characters stuck on the device's input line, which then glued themselves to whatever you typed next — -sh: rcat: command not found. The cancel sequence was missing the half that clears the line.
  • The ZMODEM hint had it backwards. ZMODEM is the one where the sender speaks first, and the app types rz on the device for you — so there is nothing to run there beforehand.
